node.title: Re^4: Capture STDOUT and send to screen with open3 (updated)
node.author: computergeek
node.doctext:
I am sorry, I am trying it and it hangs. Here is what I am executing: What am I doing wrong? Also, will this print a line real time from cat as if output were not being captured?

my @cat = qw( cat ); run \@cat, '', new_chunker("\n"), sub { my $line = shift; print $line; push @out, $line; }, '2>', new_chunker("\n"), sub { my $line = shift; print STDERR $line; push @err, $line; } or die $?; print PIPE "some input\n"; close PIPE; print "out @out"; print "err @err";
